sources.entry: 🧰 Free for developers: list of free tiers for developments tools and services

summary.title: Free for Developers
summary.one_liner: A curated, categorized list of as-a-Service products (cloud, DevOps, APIs, source hosting and more) that offer free developer tiers, useful for picking tools without paying.
takeaways: Shows free-tier limits for major cloud providers (Google Cloud, AWS, Azure, Oracle, IBM, Cloudflare) such as request counts, storage and build minutes.
Explains the list's inclusion rules: only as-a-Service offerings, a real free tier rather than a trial, and time-bucketed tiers lasting at least a year.
Lists free plans across many categories, including source code repos, APIs and data, cloud management, and Zoho's suite of services.
Useful as a starting point for comparing free options, but limits and availability change over time and some entries are flagged as possibly retired.
summary.summary: This is a categorized directory of SaaS, PaaS and IaaS products that offer free developer tiers, aimed mainly at infrastructure engineers such as sysadmins and DevOps practitioners. The page states its inclusion criteria: self-hosted software is excluded, a free trial alone does not qualify, and time-limited free tiers must last at least a year. Each entry gives a one-line description and the key free-tier limits, such as monthly requests, storage, or number of users. The visible portion covers major cloud providers, Zoho, cloud management tools, source code hosting, and a large APIs/data/ML section, with many more categories listed in the table of contents.
